subject: ela
intro: There are different kinds of books. A storybook tells a made-up story. A poem uses short lines and often rhymes. A sign gives short words to tell us something. Kindergartners learn to tell these apart.

items.prompt:
This book tells about a dragon who makes friends. It has made-up characters.

What kind of text is it?

steps: It tells a made-up story with characters.
A book that tells a story is a storybook.

items.prompt:
This text has short lines and the ends rhyme: 'The cat sat. On a mat.'

What kind of text is it?

steps: It has short lines and words that rhyme.

items.prompt:
This text says 'STOP' in big letters on the road.

What kind of text is it?

steps: It is a few words that tell us what to do.

items.prompt: A text that rhymes in short lines is a ____.

steps: Rhyming short lines make a poem.

items.prompt: A book that tells a made-up story is a ____.

steps: A made-up story is a storybook.

items.prompt: Words on the wall that say 'EXIT' are a ____.

steps: A word that tells us something is a sign.
